prompt: You are given a folder named "log_folder" in your current working directory containing log files from a server. These log files are named in the format "log_YYYY-MM-DD.txt" (for example, "log_2022-10-01.txt"). Your task is to find out the number of log files in the "log_folder" that were created exactly 30 days or more ago from the current date. Make sure to operate within the "log_folder" directory for this task.
